\caption{Effect of the VAE training objective on geometric ending scoring, all rows on the full 10{,}042-example validation set so the deltas are same-set. Every GMN variant shares the same 624{,}256 trainable parameters and the same frozen sentence encoder; only the training objective changes. Adding a margin-ranking loss to reconstruction widens the correct-vs-wrong cosine gap (0.027 $\to$ 0.047) but buys nothing (p = 0.3083). Training the head end-to-end on the 4-way scoring objective is the first change that helps (+1.1 points, p = 0.0034), while producing by far the \emph{smallest} cosine gap (0.007): the gap is not what carries the signal. $^*$post-hoc temperature selection on this same set; the pre-registered configuration is the row above. `n.s.' marks $p\ge0.05$.}
